chapter.heading: Psalm 134
Come, Bless the LORD
A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
Come, bless
the LORD,,
all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the house of the LORD!

Lift up
your hands,
to the holy place and bless the LORD!

May the
LORD bless,
you from Zion, he who made heaven and earth! (ESV)
